C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 181
Date 21/3/16

Municipal Police.
Criminal Investigation Dept:
Captain Superintendents Office,

Shanghai, 18th March 1916.

Sir,
Liang Chi Tsao 梁啟超 No.103 Bubbling Well Road, is away from Shanghai at present. Some of his servants, who are still in the house, state that he went to Japan on 3rd instant, and will return to Shanghai about the end of this month.
It is reported that Chiangchun Feng has notified General Yang that twenty aeroplanes, purchased in America by the Chinese Government, will arrive here in the near future. General Yang is instructed to make arrangements with the Commissioner of Customs to allow the aeroplanes to pass through to Nanking without delay.
A General named Tsang Tsung Sung 張振聲 arrived at the Arsenal yesterday from Peking. He has come here for the purpose of conferring with General Yang and Lui about the local situation.
It is reported that the Central Government intends to send some of thr troops at present stationed in Shanghai to Yunnan.
The Director of the Arsenal received telegraphic instructions yesterday to make six 7.5 cm. guns and sixteen machine guns within a month. The Director wired a reply saying that he was unable to comply with the order and complaining of the scarcity of steel and iron.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事调查处
情报官登记处
编号 181
日期 1916年3月21日

公共租界警务处。
刑事调查处：
警司办公室，

上海，1916年3月18日。

先生：

梁启超（住址：静安寺路103号）目前不在上海。其留在家中的部分仆人称，他已于本月3日前往日本，并将于本月月底左右返回上海。

据报，蒋尊簋（音译）已通知杨将军，中国政府在美国购买的二十架飞机将于近期抵达此处。杨将军奉命与税务司协调，以便让这些飞机毫无延误地运往南京。

一位名为张振声的将军昨日从北京抵达兵工厂。他此行的目的是就本地局势与杨将军及吕氏（音译）进行磋商。

据报，中央政府打算将目前驻守上海的部分部队调往云南。

兵工厂总监昨日收到电报指示，要求在一个月内制造六门7.5厘米口径火炮和十六挺机枪。总监回电表示无法执行该命令，并抱怨钢铁短缺。

您顺从的仆人，

首席探长

警司
